blurb: Catching Adventures is a fishing guide service for beginners and those who love fishing! Offering year round guided adventures on the lake, fly fishing on North Shore rivers, and winter ice fishing. Our goal is to provide an enjoyable, exciting, and educational experience for all anglers. Join us for a perfect outdoor fishing adventure in Northern Minnesota! Families, couples, out of state travelers, and groups
